crypto.dhtKey: HKDF of the invite key and an X25519 shared secret of both participation keys
crypto.dhtSignature: Ed25519, by the sender's participation key
crypto.epochSecret: Sealed to each member with X25519 (ECDH) + XChaCha20-Poly1305
crypto.holdKey: HKDF of the link's hold secret and an X25519 shared secret of both participation keys
crypto.hyperBinding: The Noise handshake hash, in the signed transcript
crypto.hyperChannel: HyperDHT stream: Noise (XX) handshake, encrypted transport
crypto.irohBinding: The Iroh connection's context, in the signed transcript
crypto.irohChannel: Iroh: QUIC with TLS 1.3 (raw public keys)
crypto.legacyCipher: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (NaCl secretbox) with the chat's shared key
crypto.pinnedTofu: {{key}} · trusted on first use, not compared
crypto.sessionAuth: Ed25519 (paired-chat/1): each side signs the transcript with its participation key
crypto.webrtcBinding: Both DTLS certificate fingerprints, in the signed transcript
crypto.webrtcChannel: WebRTC data channel: DTLS 1.2+ with SCTP

delivery.queued: Not confirmed yet, sends again by itself

storage.native: a file kept by the desktop app
storage.opfs: a file in the origin's private file system

summary.dhtConfirmed: {{thing}} sent on the DHT, sealed end to end, confirmed.
summary.dhtConfirmedAfter: {{thing}} sent on the DHT, sealed end to end, confirmed after {{receipt}}.
summary.dhtWaiting: {{thing}} sent on the DHT, sealed end to end, waiting for the receipt.
summary.fileNotSent: {{thing}} not sent: its bytes did not go.
summary.fileNotSentOver: {{thing}} not sent: its bytes did not go over {{over}}.
summary.held: {{thing}} held in your storage, sealed for your contact, waiting to be picked up.
summary.heldPickedUp: {{thing}} held in your storage, sealed for your contact, picked up {{after}} later.
summary.heldSent: {{thing}} held in your storage, sealed for your contact.
summary.live: {{thing}} sent live over {{over}}, encrypted end to end.
summary.liveDelivered: {{thing}} sent live over {{over}}, encrypted end to end, delivered.
summary.liveReceipt: {{thing}} sent live over {{over}}, encrypted end to end, receipt in {{receipt}}.
summary.liveReceiptTry: {{thing}} sent live over {{over}}, encrypted end to end, receipt in {{receipt}} on the {{nth}} try.
summary.liveWaiting: {{thing}} sent live over {{over}}, encrypted end to end, waiting for the receipt.
summary.localNote: A note kept on this device only. Nothing was sent for it.
summary.queued: {{thing}} sent {{count}} times without a receipt. It goes again by itself.
summary.queuedOne: {{thing}} sent 1 time without a receipt. It goes again by itself.
summary.queuedOneOver: {{thing}} sent 1 time over {{over}} without a receipt. It goes again by itself.
summary.queuedOver: {{thing}} sent {{count}} times over {{over}} without a receipt. It goes again by itself.
summary.receivedDht: {{thing}} received from the DHT, sealed end to end, {{after}} after it was written (two clocks).
summary.receivedHold: {{thing}} picked up from your contact's storage, sealed for you, {{after}} after it was written.
summary.receivedLive: {{thing}} received live over {{over}}, encrypted end to end.
summary.waiting: {{thing}} not sent yet: it goes by itself when the chat can carry it.

value.contactNotShown: Not shown yet: it goes when the chat is live and their app shows edits
value.fileCancelled: Not sent: the file was cancelled
value.fileDeclined: Not sent: the contact declined the file
value.fileFailed: Not sent: the file did not go
value.groupNotSent: Not sent yet: it goes as soon as the group can take it
